independent_reproduction.exception_when_reproduced_without_the_he: ValueError: Expected include item to be one of documents, embeddings, metadatas, distances, uris, data, got ids in query.

root_cause: uruha_memory_runtime.query_collection_candidates includes ids in Chroma query include; Chroma returns ids automatically and rejects ids as an include item. The helper catches the exception and silently returns an empty list.
scope_boundary: The direct episode and wisdom text queries still work. The defect specifically disables persistent memories as scored working-memory candidates.
